aboutpara: I am an MCA student at Mepco Schlenk Engineering College with a strong interest in Java Full Stack development. I have knowledge of Java, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Spring Boot and MySQL. I enjoy building practical applications, solving programming problems and learning new technologies. I am a quick learner with strong debugging, analytical, communication and teamwork skills.

resume.tagline: 👋 I'm Asmitha A, an aspiring Java Full Stack Developer.
resume.description: I am currently pursuing Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at Mepco Schlenk Engineering College with a CGPA of 8.75. I have hands-on knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and I am looking for opportunities to apply my skills in real-world software development projects.
